Resolution summary, 9/28.

Issue: Joe Austin reported Smart Alerts stopped triggering around 9/23 for Vitamin Shoppe, client 433. Client 433 showed 68 "still on processing" exits in the unfiltered Grafana export of 9/25, 20:05 to 23:40 UTC, the same pattern as RCS-29123. The start date for 433 was not confirmed in Grafana.

Cause, per Kiran Vadday on RCS-29123: deadlock in ProcessSmartAlert when runs process in parallel.

Fix: PR 58273, deployed to US prod on 9/28.

Verification: Joe ran a test alert on 9/28 and confirmed it arrived.

Open: the fix does not reprocess cases stuck with InProcess = 1. Alerts missed from 9/23 to 9/28 were not resent. Customer was offered a manual resend by case number.

Related: RCS-29123, RCS-29026, RETAILIT-20901.

","created":"2026-09-28T18:19:15.691-0400","updated":"2026-09-28T18:19:15.691-0400","updateAuthor":{"accountId":"712020:688bd119-6d13-450b-95ac-b1ef3fbb547b","displayName":"Juan Martinez"},"jsdPublic":false},{"id":"3370899","author":{"accountId":"712020:688bd119-6d13-450b-95ac-b1ef3fbb547b","displayName":"Juan Martinez"},"body":"

Hello @Joe Austin ,

Thank you for testing it so quickly, and for confirming it came through.

Our engineering team found that Smart Alert runs were blocking each other when several cases processed at the same time, so some alerts stayed pending and never went out. A change released on 9/28 makes each run wait for the previous one, and alerts are processing normally again.

I will go ahead and close this one out. If anything comes back, just reply here and it will reopen.

Juan
